bandReport.notes: Both seams are clean. p08 (not mine) ends with Q50 complete — it carries two 'Consider the following for the next two (02) items' blocks, one opening the left column (grouped frequency table, Q47-48) and one opening the right column (quadratic equation, Q49-50); both START on p08, so band b2 owns all four and none is transcribed here. p13 (not mine) opens with Q77 fresh at the top of the left column, so Q76 is not truncated. NO Directions / 'Consider the following' block starts anywhere in p09-p12: all 26 questions in this band are standalone. NO printed figures and NO data tables anywhere in p09-p12 — every question is stated entirely in words. Q73 mentions 'the figure thus formed' but the book prints no diagram for it; the figure is described in the stem, so hasFigure is not set.

questions.stem: What is the radius of the sphere passing through the corners of the cuboid with edges 8 cm, 12 cm and 24 cm ?

A lamp shade is in the shape of a part of a cone and its top and bottom ends are circles whose circumferences are respectively 30 cm and 40 cm. The perpendicular distance between the ends is 6 cm. If the cone were to be completed, then how far would its vertex be from the top end ?
A sum of money at 20% rate of compound interest per annum becomes more than 100 times in n years. What is the least value of n ? (Use \(\log_{10} 2 = 0.301\), \(\log_{10} 3 = 0.477\))

The corners of an equilateral triangular plate were cut in such a manner that it forms a regular hexagonal plate. What is the ratio of the area of the triangular plate to the area of the hexagonal plate ?
flags: Invented subtopic 'Areas of Regular Polygons' — the catalog's Mensuration 2D list has no entry covering a regular hexagon. Closest listed options ('Areas of Triangles and Quadrilaterals', 'Inscribed and Circumscribed Figures') both misdescribe a truncated-triangle-to-hexagon area ratio.

questions.stem: Two equal arcs of different circles \(C_1\) and \(C_2\) subtend angles of \(60^\circ\) and \(75^\circ\) respectively, at the centres. What is the ratio of the radius of \(C_1\) to the radius of \(C_2\) ?
ABC is a triangle with sides AB = 41 cm, BC = 28 cm and CA = 15 cm. If D, E and F are the mid-points of AB, BC and CA respectively, then what is the area of the triangle DEF ?
A triangle has sides 13 cm, 14 cm and 15 cm long. What is the length of the smallest altitude of the triangle ?
questions.subtopic: Altitudes and Sides of a Triangle

questions.stem: The circumference of a circle exceeds the diameter by 16.8 cm. What is the diameter of the circle ? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))
The hypotenuse AC of a right-angled ABC is \(3\sqrt{5}\) cm. If AB is doubled and BC is tripled such that ABC remains a right-angled triangle, the hypotenuse becomes 15 cm. What is AB + BC equal to ?
flags: Printed as 'a right-angled ABC' — the word 'triangle' is omitted before ABC in the first sentence (it is present in the second). Transcribed as printed.

questions.stem: What is the area of the region between two concentric circles if the chord of the outer circle of length 14 cm is a tangent of the inner circle ? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))
A pendulum swings through an angle of \(9^\circ\) and its end describes an arc of length 14.3 cm. What is the length of the pendulum ? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))
The arch of a bridge is in the form of an arc of a circle. If the span of the bridge is 40 m and height in the middle is 8 m, then what is the radius of curvature of the bridge ?

If a, b and c are the sides of a right-angled triangle, where a > b > c, then what is the value of the expression
\((a + b + c) (a + b - c) (a - b + c) (a - b - c)\) ?
The cube root of x varies inversely as the square root of y. x = 8 when y = 3. What is the value of x when \(y = \sqrt[3]{3}\) ?

Three solid lead spheres of diameters 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm are melted together and recast as a solid sphere. What is the percentage diminution of the surface area as compared to the sum of the surface areas of the three spheres ?
A solid sphere of radius 3 cm is melted to form a hollow cylinder of height 4 cm and external diameter 10 cm. What is the thickness of the cylinder ?

Three glasses P, Q and R have capacities in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3. All these glasses are completely filled with mixtures of milk and water. The ratio of milk to water in P is 1 : 2, in Q it is 2 : 3 and in R it is 3 : 1. If the content of all three glasses are put into a bigger container, what will be the ratio of milk to water in the container ?

What is
\(\frac{x^2 - y^2 - z^2 - 2yz}{x^2 + y^2 - z^2 + 2xy} + \frac{x^2 - y^2 - z^2 - 2yz}{x^2 - y^2 + z^2 - 2xz}\)
equal to ?

If \(\tan A + \cot A = 2\), where \(0 < A < 90^\circ\), then what is the value of
\(\tan^2 A + \tan^3 A + \tan^4 A + .... + \tan^n A\) ?

Which of the following is/are identity/identities ?
1. \(\frac{\sin^3 \theta + \cos^3 \theta}{\sin \theta + \cos \theta} + \sin \theta \cos \theta = 1\); \(0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\)
2. \(1 - \sin^6 \theta = \cos^2 \theta (\cos^4 \theta + 3 \sin^2 \theta)\)
Select the correct answer using the code given below :
If \(7 \sin^4 \theta + 9 \cos^4 \theta + 42 \sin^2 \theta = 16\), \(0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\), then what is \(\tan \theta\) equal to ?
An isosceles triangle has its base length 2a and its height is h. On each side of the triangle a square is drawn external to the triangle. What is the area of the figure thus formed ?
If \(p = \frac{a^2}{(b - a)(c - a)}\), \(q = \frac{b^2}{(c - b)(a - b)}\), \(r = \frac{c^2}{(a - c)(b - c)}\), then what is \((p + q + r)^2\) equal to ?
Which one of the following is a factor of \(a^2 - b^2 - c^2 + 2bc + a + b - c\) ?
